role: frozen fully supervised reference arm for paired WSL supervision-gap experiments

weak_supervision_isolation.reference_training_supervision: BTXRD train ground-truth polygons rasterized to binary masks
weak_supervision_isolation.experimental_training_supervision: pseudo-masks generated from radiographs and image-level labels only
weak_supervision_isolation.validation_gt_usage: post-prediction evaluation and subgroup diagnosis only

data.grouping_limitation: BTXRD publishes no patient/case identifier; the frozen manifest uses audited consecutive-ID plus stable-metadata heuristic grouping.

consumer_training_contract.preprocessing: RGB resize to 448x448 and ImageNet normalization
consumer_training_contract.augmentation: paired random horizontal flip with probability 0.5 on train only
consumer_training_contract.checkpoint_selection: maximum validation tumor-only Dice at fixed threshold 0.5; tie-break by normal empty-mask specificity within Dice tolerance 0.0001
consumer_training_contract.paired_experiment_rule: The WSL consumer must use this complete contract unchanged; only the train mask source may differ.

evaluation_contract.primary_population: all validation tumor images, including complete misses
evaluation_contract.threshold_selection: independently per arm on validation: maximize mean tumor-only Dice, then normal empty-prediction rate, then proximity to 0.5
evaluation_contract.success_rule: absolute difference between WSL and GT-reference mean tumor-only Dice is <= 0.05 separately for small, medium and large
evaluation_contract.bootstrap: 10,000 paired resamples of complete validation groups with seed 42

audit_notes.legacy_snapshot_verifier: superseded for cross-platform hashing because its text manifest mixed historical and platform-specific byte representations
